MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

2. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 33
   C. 28
   D. 14

7. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.25
   D. 2.5

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

9. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 15
   D. 30

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

12. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 30
   D. 60

15. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 6
   C. 36
   D. 7

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 36
   C. 30
   D. 18

17. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

18. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

19. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 50
   C. 100
   D. 11

20. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

21. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

22. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 1, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 2, 4, 6

23. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

24. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 8
   C. 64
   D. 9

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 20
   C. 30
   D. 75

26. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 22
   C. 32
   D. 16

27. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 81

28. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 22

29. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 22
   D. 77

30. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
